summary: Iteration 7 fully verified. Backend 9/9 new tests + 14/14 iteration-6 regression tests passed (TestHealthSync from iter-6 intentionally excluded — endpoint now 403s by design until health_sync permission is enabled; new gate test covers both states). New features verified: coach memory (history persisted/reflected in replies when ON; GET /api/coach/history empty and nothing stored when OFF; UI hides history on fresh mount when OFF and restores when re-enabled), structured recipe cards (fenced JSON parsed, RecipeCard renders name/time/kcal/protein/ingredients/numbered steps, 'Log as meal' posts /api/meals and reflects in dashboard), health-sync 403 gate + idempotent upsert after enabling. CRITICAL LAYOUT BUG not reproducible on web: audits at 390x844 and 320x568 in English AND Telugu across Today, Plan, Coach, Progress, Settings, Eat-Now, Log-Food show zero document overflow, zero element overflow (Plan day chips extend past viewport inside their horizontal ScrollView by design), no one-char-per-line wrapping, no clipped headings, no collapsed containers. Auth guards pass: unauthenticated /settings, /eat-now, / all redirect to /welcome. Onboarding regression: fresh account signup -> 3 steps -> lands on Today. Google Sign-In initiates handoff to auth.emergentagent.com without crashing. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: Returns up to 30 messages but recipe payloads are not persisted in db.coach_messages (only text), so recipe cards do not survive a session restore — acceptable trade-off but worth noting

integration_issues.issue: Coach screen fetches /coach/history only on mount (useEffect []); if the user toggles Coach memory in Settings and returns via tab bar (screens stay mounted), stale messages remain visible until a full remount. Verified correct behavior on fresh mount — minor staleness only.

issues: Telugu conjunct clusters still render with dotted-circle shaping artifacts on web preview (e.g. 'తెలుగు' chip, Settings header) — Telugu-capable font (Noto Sans Telugu) still not bundled in web build; carried over from iteration 6, no overflow/clipping otherwise

react_native_issues.issue: No deprecated packages found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). Reference: /app/frontend/package.json

action_items: Bundle Noto Sans Telugu via expo-font so Telugu clusters shape correctly on web (fixes dotted-circle artifacts)
Optional: refetch /coach/history on coach tab focus (useFocusEffect) so memory-toggle changes take effect without remount
Optional: persist recipe JSON alongside coach messages so recipe cards survive history restore
critical_code_review_comments: Recipe parsing is well-defended: regex + json.loads with per-field clamping (time 1-180, calories 0-2000, lists capped), raw fence stripped from reply text, JSON failure -> recipe=null graceful fallback
Coach memory gate is consistent: history read, context injection, and persistence all keyed on prefs.coach_memory !== false (default-on); verified nothing stored while off
health/sync 403 gate reads fresh permissions per request; upsert idempotency (user_id, external_id, source) still intact
styles.ts responsive fixes are systematic (flex minWidth:0, explicit lineHeight on all headings, chip maxWidth 100%, flexShrink:0 on fixed-size row children) — no layout regressions detected at 320px
Auth guards in settings.tsx use Redirect with loading state; deep links correctly bounce to /welcome
seed_data_creation: Preview account: recipe-logged meal 'Paneer & Mixed-Veg Quinoa Stir-Fry', eat-now logged meal, walk+strength activities, weight 67.8, plan meal log, 16 coach messages retained (2 TEST-marker messages cleaned up). New throwaway account test.iter7.8cf29125@example.com created for onboarding regression. Permissions restored to original: coach_memory=true, health_sync=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coach history only loads on mount — use page.goto(full URL) not tab taps to test history changes. Settings toggle clicks can race the initial /permissions fetch; wait ~4s after settings-screen before toggling and verify state afterwards (in-page fetch needs localStorage key 'nutrimitra.session.token'). Plan day chips legitimately extend past viewport (horizontal ScrollView) — exclude them from overflow checks. Coach recipe card testID pattern recipe-card-<index>, log button recipe-log-<index>. Google sign-in navigates away from SPA — always test last.
mocked_apis: No mocked APIs. Groq (openai/gpt-oss-120b) live for chat/recipe; vision falls back to Emergent universal key by design (no vision models on Groq key).
